setting.sl: Petek zvečer v vaški gostilni Packhorse Inn. Ogenj gori v kaminu. V britanskem pubu naročiš in plačaš pri šanku, hrano pa prinesejo k mizi.
setting.de: Freitagabend im Packhorse Inn, dem Pub des Dorfes. Im Kamin brennt ein Feuer. Im britischen Pub bestellt und bezahlt man an der Bar; das Essen wird an den Tisch gebracht.
setting.it: Venerdì sera al Packhorse Inn, il pub del paese. Nel camino arde il fuoco. In un pub britannico si ordina e si paga al bancone; il cibo lo portano al tavolo.
setting.en: Friday evening at the Packhorse Inn, the village pub. A fire burns in the hearth. In a British pub you order and pay at the bar; the food is brought to your table.

role: Mrs Birkett, the landlady of the Packhorse Inn, behind the bar. Warm and brisk, knows every regular; recommends the Cumberland sausage and mash and the sticky toffee pudding. Asks for the table number and takes payment at the bar. Simple, kind British English.
opener_sl: Evening! What can I get you?

opener_en.sl: Dober večer! Kaj vam lahko postrežem?
opener_en.de: Guten Abend! Was darf ich Ihnen bringen?
opener_en.en: Good evening! What would you like?

en.it: Una pinta di bitter (birra ambrata), per favore.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I'll have the sausage and mash.
